project.name: Destiny OS :: Engine :: I Ching / Mai Hoa
project.description:
Kinh Dich (I Ching) hexagram casting and Mai Hoa Dich So - research item R12, resolved 2026-08-24 for the mechanical (draw-and-identify) layer after Opus verification found no error in the Sonnet-gathered research and independently derived the Yarrow method's own probability distribution from its procedure.
Ships four casting methods (Three Coins, Yarrow stalks, Mai Hoa Number, Mai Hoa Year-Month-Day-Hour), the 64-hexagram Van Vuong lookup table, moving-line determination and the changed hexagram - all primary-sourced or, where only secondary consensus exists (the mod-6 remainder-zero convention), a declared Rule D decision (DECISION_LOG.md, 2026-08-24).
Does NOT ship: which line's text to read when several lines move at once (interpretation layer, Rule B - a later concern once judgement/line text content is authored, the same split Tarot's R11 content already went through), or the multi-digit single-number-to-trigrams splitting rule (secondary sources only, the primary text does not contain it - the Number method requires two supplied numbers instead).
Framework-free, like the other engines. Depends on destiny-calendar only for the Year-Month-Day-Hour casting method's lunar date and hour-branch conversion.
